saw_lines: Designer sofa buyers research for weeks, compare leather grades, and often need a partner to sign off.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad itself, since a buyer who scrolls past rarely comes back.
Your 11 Google ads are 10 text and 1 image, last shown April 2024. Shoot three sofa photos in real rooms and pair them with a fabric sample offer.
ads_1: Sofa room photos with a fabric sample offer, replacing the text only Google ads
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram, your two linked channels
